'''2007 Utah State Championship Trevor Ewald DS Tatooine Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Trevor Ewald]] at [[2007 Utah State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine Occupation|SE-D-tatooineoccupation.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Trevol Ewald
* '''Deck name:''' Dark
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
